eventDescription:
The 1500 Manjapai distribution ceremony organized by Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board, Vidhaigal Thanarava Amaipu and Thiruveni Academy.

The presence of District Environmental Assistant Engineer Rangasamy, Muthuraj, and Principal of Triveni Academy M.P. Anand further enhanced the significance of the ceremony. Providing Manjapai to the students and making them aware of the need to reduce the use of plastic will create a positive change in the society.

More than 100 students participated in this ceremony which will help them play an important role in environmental protection in the future.
